description: Wildblood incursion. Fires off the night clock with nothing local required, which is what stops it reading as the city's own trouble coming to a head. ⚠ The street gets the direction right and the wire gets it wrong: they come UP, out of the Under, which was theirs before the Basin was poured over it. The perimeter genuinely was not breached. It was also never the way in.
name: They came up in the night

stage.text: Something goes over a roofline two streets off, heavy, and lands running.

stage.warn: Close by, people are moving fast and low along the backs of the buildings, and not one of them is talking.

lines: The street is empty the way a street gets when everybody made the same decision at the same moment.
There is a smear up the wall at head height that is not paint and has not dried.
Somebody's shopping is all over the pavement and nobody has come back for it.

stage.text: They came up through the Under again on {place}. Up. Not down off the wastes. Everybody keeps getting that the wrong way round and it keeps costing them.
A localised public-order event toward {place} has been resolved — the Basin perimeter was not breached at any point and there is no evidence of external involvement.
